summary: BTC ~$77.5k, +0.1% in 24h, slipped from ~$78.7k this morning. US spot BTC ETFs had ~$203M net outflows last week. Election week (US midterms Tue) and Friday's jobs report are the near-term risk; traders watch $76k support and $80.5k resistance. Binance now restoring fiat withdrawals after the hack, which eases that overhang.
